• `v` → open app: Karabiner-EventViewer

to.shell_command:
d="/tmp/karabiner.script-example"; [ -d "$d" ] || mkdir -p "$d"
exec zsh -c '
  zmodload zsh/datetime
  source "$HOME/.config/zsh/plugins/log_rotate.zsh"
  log_rotate "$1" "$2" 2>/dev/null
  export REPO_ROOT="$HOME/.config/karabiner/karabiner.ts"
  export REPO_LIB="${REPO_ROOT}/src/scripts/lib"
  export PATH="$HOME/.config/bin:/Users/arisweedler/h/node/env-22.14.0/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:${PATH}"
  {
    strftime "%a %b %e %H:%M:%S %Z %Y" "$EPOCHSECONDS"
    cd "${REPO_ROOT:?}"
    print -r -- "Invoking /Users/arisweedler/.config/karabiner/karabiner.ts/src/scripts/bin/script-example"
    typeset -F _s=$EPOCHREALTIME
    "/Users/arisweedler/.config/karabiner/karabiner.ts/src/scripts/bin/script-example"
    _rc=$?
    typeset -F _e=$EPOCHREALTIME
    printf "elapsed_ms=%.0f rc=%d\n" $(( (_e - _s) * 1000 )) $_rc
    exit $_rc
  } &> "$1"
' _ "/tmp/karabiner.script-example/log.txt" "5"

rules.description:
(hyper + w): Window management

• `⌫` → restore
• `⏎` → almost-maximize
• `h` → left-half
• `l` → right-half
• `q` → left-third
• `w` → center-third
• `e` → right-third
• `u` → top-left-quarter
• `i` → top-right-quarter
• `j` → bottom-left-quarter
• `k` → bottom-right-quarter
• `c` → center
• `r` → reasonable-size
• `f` → toggle-fullscreen
• `-` → make-smaller
• `=` → make-larger
• `,` → previous-display
• `.` → next-display
• `[` → previous-desktop
• `]` → next-desktop
